notes: First-person mech combat with gatling guns and rockets is Shooter, and the answers fix the mode as free-for-all, which among the mode presets is Arena Deathmatch rather than any of the team rows. Swapped the preset's lane-network for open-battlefield and dropped its path-loop, because what was asked for is a compact 500-stud terrain field of trees and doodads with dispersed points of interest, not lanes or interconnected rooms; kept powerup-buffs and cover-elevated, and swapped spawn-teambase for spawn-protected since a free-for-all has no opposing bases. The explicit request for interesting terrain lands on terrain-relief, which is what puts tiered on the route — no overhangs were asked for, so this stays a P0-family build. The HUD meshes, weapon behaviour and mech scale are not layout concerns and carry through only as the 3x-avatar sizing on a deliberately compact battlefield.
